children.summary_ja: 連結自己資本規制比率の算出に用いる普通株式等Tier1比率・その他Tier1比率・Tier2比率の計算式を定める条文。
children.summary_en: Sets out the formulas for calculating the CET1 ratio, AT1 ratio, and Tier 2 ratio used to determine the consolidated capital adequacy ratio.

children.heading: 連結自己資本規制比率の計算方法
children.text_ja: 最終指定親会社及びその子法人等の自己資本の充実の状況が適当であることの基準(以下「連結自己資本規制比率」という。)であって、最終指定親会社及びその子法人等の適当な自己資本の充実の状況の最低基準は、次の各号に掲げる比率(以下「最低所要連結自己資本規制比率」と総称する。)の区分に応じ、当該各号に定めるところによる。一連結普通株式等Tier1比率次の算式により得られる比率について、四・五パーセント以上とする。二連結Tier1比率次の算式により得られる比率について、六パーセント以上とする。三連結総自己資本規制比率次の算式により得られる比率について、八パーセント以上とする。
children.text_en: The standard for determining that the capital adequacy status of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company and its subsidiary legal entities, etc. is appropriate (hereinafter referred to as the "Consolidated Capital Adequacy Ratio") — the minimum standard for appropriate capital adequacy status of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company and its subsidiary legal entities, etc. shall be, in accordance with the classification of ratios listed in the following items (hereinafter collectively referred to as the "Minimum Required Consolidated Capital Adequacy Ratios"), as provided in each such item. (i) Consolidated Common Equity Tier 1 Ratio: regarding the ratio obtained by the following formula, it shall be 4.5% or more. (ii) Consolidated Tier 1 Ratio: regarding the ratio obtained by the following formula, it shall be 6% or more. (iii) Consolidated Total Capital Adequacy Ratio: regarding the ratio obtained by the following formula, it shall be 8% or more.

children.summary_en: Sets out the TLAC ratio and CET1 buffer ratio formulas applicable to Ultimate Designated Parent Companies subject to TLAC requirements (designated securities firms).

children.text_ja: 連結自己資本規制比率であって、最終指定親会社及びその子法人等の適当な自己資本の充実の状況の前条各号に定める基準以外の基準は、連結資本バッファー比率(次の算式により得られる比率をいう。)について、最低連結資本バッファー比率以上とする。
children.text_en: Among the Consolidated Capital Adequacy Ratios, the standards for appropriate capital adequacy status of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company and its subsidiary legal entities, etc. other than the standards set forth in the items of the preceding Article shall be that the Consolidated Capital Buffer Ratio (meaning the ratio obtained by the following formula) shall be equal to or greater than the Minimum Consolidated Capital Buffer Ratio.

defined_terms.term_ja: 連結資本バッファー比率

children.text_ja: 前項の「最低連結資本バッファー比率」とは、資本保全バッファー比率及びカウンター・シクリカル・バッファー比率を合計したものをいう。
children.text_en: The "Minimum Consolidated Capital Buffer Ratio" referred to in the preceding paragraph means the sum of the Capital Conservation Buffer Ratio and the Countercyclical Buffer Ratio.

clauses_ja.text: 前項の「最低連結資本バッファー比率」とは、資本保全バッファー比率及びカウンター・シクリカル・バッファー比率を合計したものをいう。

clauses_en.text: The "Minimum Consolidated Capital Buffer Ratio" referred to in the preceding paragraph means the sum of the Capital Conservation Buffer Ratio and the Countercyclical Buffer Ratio.

defined_terms.term_ja: 最低連結資本バッファー比率

children.text_ja: 前項の「資本保全バッファー比率」とは、金融市場の動向又は経済情勢の変化によって生じるおそれのある損失の吸収のため資本を増強する基準となるものをいい、二・五パーセントとする。
children.text_en: The "Capital Conservation Buffer Ratio" referred to in the preceding paragraph means the standard for strengthening capital in order to absorb losses that may arise from trends in financial markets or changes in economic conditions, and shall be 2.5%.

clauses_ja.text: 前項の「資本保全バッファー比率」とは、金融市場の動向又は経済情勢の変化によって生じるおそれのある損失の吸収のため資本を増強する基準となるものをいい、二・五パーセントとする。

clauses_en.text: The "Capital Conservation Buffer Ratio" referred to in the preceding paragraph means the standard for strengthening capital in order to absorb losses that may arise from trends in financial markets or changes in economic conditions, and shall be 2.5%.

defined_terms.term_ja: 資本保全バッファー比率

children.text_ja: 第二項の「カウンター・シクリカル・バッファー比率」とは、金融市場における信用の供与が過剰な場合に、将来の景気の変動によって生ずるおそれのある損失の吸収のため資本を増強する基準となるものをいい、次に掲げる比率を合計して得た比率(小数点以下二位未満の端数があるときは、これを切り捨てるものとする。)とする。一零パーセント(金融庁長官が別に指定した場合は、別に指定した比率)に、信用リスク・アセットの額(ソブリン向けエクスポージャー及び金融機関等向けエクスポージャーに係る信用リスク・アセットの額並びにCVAリスク相当額を除く。次号において同じ。)の合計額とデフォルト・リスクに対するマーケット・リスク相当額(ソブリン向けエクスポージャー及び金融機関等向けエクスポージャーに係るデフォルト・リスクに対するマーケット・リスク相当額を除き、簡易的方式採用最終指定親会社にあっては、第二百七十一条第一項各号に掲げるリスク・カテゴリーに対するマーケット・リスク相当額のうち個別リスクの額に係るもの。次号において同じ。)の合計額を八パーセントで除して得た額とを合算した額のうち本邦に係るものを当該額で除して得た値を乗じて得た比率二本邦以外の国又は地域の金融当局が定める比率(二・五パーセントを超える場合には、二・五パーセント)に、信用リスク・アセットの額の合計額とデフォルト・リスクに対するマーケット・リスク相当額の合計額を八パーセントで除して得た額とを合算した額のうち当該国又は地域に係るものを当該額で除して得た値を乗じて得た比率を合計して得た比率
children.text_en: The "Countercyclical Buffer Ratio" referred to in paragraph 2 means the standard for strengthening capital in order to absorb losses that may arise from future economic fluctuations when the supply of credit in financial markets is excessive, and shall be the ratio obtained by summing the ratios listed in the following items (any fraction below the second decimal place shall be rounded down). (i) The ratio obtained by multiplying 0% (or, if separately designated by the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency, the separately designated ratio) by the value obtained by dividing the amount attributable to Japan in the sum of: the total amount of credit risk-weighted assets (excluding credit risk-weighted assets relating to sovereign exposures and exposures to financial institutions, etc. and CVA risk equivalent amounts; the same applies in the following item) and the amount obtained by dividing the total amount of market risk equivalent for default risk (excluding those relating to sovereign exposures and exposures to financial institutions, etc.; in the case of an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the simplified approach, those related to specific risk among the market risk equivalents for each risk category listed in the items of Article 271, paragraph (1); the same applies in the following item) by 8% — by that sum; (ii) The ratio obtained by summing, across each country or region other than Japan, the ratio obtained by multiplying the ratio determined by the financial authorities of such country or region (capped at 2.5% where that ratio exceeds 2.5%) by the value obtained by dividing the amount attributable to such country or region in the sum of: the total amount of credit risk-weighted assets and the amount obtained by dividing the total amount of market risk equivalent for default risk by 8% — by that sum.

とする。

clauses_en.text: The "Countercyclical Buffer Ratio" referred to in paragraph 2 means the standard for strengthening capital in order to absorb losses that may arise from future economic fluctuations when the supply of credit in financial markets is excessive, and shall be the ratio obtained by summing the ratios listed in the following items
(any fraction below the second decimal place shall be rounded down).
The ratio obtained by multiplying 0%

children.heading: 連結の範囲
children.summary_ja: 連結自己資本比率の算定対象となる連結の範囲を定め、金融子会社は一部除外できる一方、保険会社等は連結範囲から完全に除外することを規定している。
children.summary_en: Sets which entities count toward the consolidated ratio calculation — generally the group's consolidated financial statements, with certain financial subsidiaries partly excludable and insurance subsidiaries excluded entirely.

children.text_ja: 連結自己資本規制比率は、最終指定親会社を連結財務諸表提出会社(連結財務諸表の用語、様式及び作成方法に関する規則(昭和五十一年大蔵省令第二十八号。以下「連結財務諸表規則」という。)第二条第一号に規定する連結財務諸表提出会社をいう。)として作成された連結財務諸表に基づき算出するものとする。ただし、最終指定親会社が銀行又は銀行法第五十二条の二十三第一項第一号から第十号まで若しくは第十五号に掲げる会社を子会社(法第二十九条の四第四項に規定する子会社をいう。以下この項において同じ。)としている場合における当該子会社(以下「金融子会社」という。)については、連結財務諸表規則第五条第二項の規定を適用しないものとする。
children.text_en: The Consolidated Capital Adequacy Ratio shall be calculated based on consolidated financial statements prepared with the Ultimate Designated Parent Company treated as a company required to submit consolidated financial statements (meaning a company required to submit consolidated financial statements as provided in Article 2, item (i) of the Regulation Concerning Terminology, Forms, and Preparation Methods of Consolidated Financial Statements (Ministry of Finance Ordinance No. 28 of 1976; hereinafter referred to as the "Consolidated Financial Statement Regulation")); provided, however, that where the Ultimate Designated Parent Company has, as a subsidiary (meaning a subsidiary as provided in Article 29-4, paragraph (4) of the Act; the same applies in this paragraph), a bank or a company listed in items (i) through (x) or item (xv) of Article 52-23, paragraph (1) of the Banking Act, the provisions of Article 5, paragraph (2) of the Consolidated Financial Statement Regulation shall not apply with respect to such subsidiary (hereinafter referred to as a "Financial Subsidiary").

children.text_ja: 前三条の規定にかかわらず、最終指定親会社は、特別金融商品取引業者及びその子法人等の保有する資産等に照らし当該特別金融商品取引業者及びその子法人等の自己資本の充実の状況が適当であるかどうかを判断するための基準を定める件(平成二十二年金融庁告示第百二十八号。以下「特別金融商品取引業者に対する連結自己資本規制比率告示」という。)の例により、連結自己資本規制比率を算出することができる。この場合において、最終指定親会社及びその子法人等の自己資本の充実の状況が適当であるかどうかを判断するための基準は、連結自己資本規制比率が百二十パーセント以上であることとする。
children.text_en: Notwithstanding the provisions of the preceding three articles, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company may calculate the Consolidated Capital Adequacy Ratio in accordance with the provisions of the Public Notice Establishing Standards for Determining Whether the Capital Adequacy Status of a Specially-Licensed Securities Business Operator and Its Subsidiary Legal Entities, etc. Is Appropriate in Light of the Assets, etc. Held by Such Specially-Licensed Securities Business Operator and Its Subsidiary Legal Entities, etc. (Financial Services Agency Public Notice No. 128 of 2010; hereinafter referred to as the "Public Notice on the Consolidated Capital Adequacy Ratio for Specially-Licensed Securities Business Operators"). In such case, the standard for determining whether the capital adequacy status of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company and its subsidiary legal entities, etc. is appropriate shall be that the Consolidated Capital Adequacy Ratio is 120% or more.

children.text_en: In the formula of Article 2, item (i), the amount of adjustment items relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital shall be the sum of the following amounts. (i) The sum of the following amounts: (a) The total amount of the following intangible fixed assets: (1) The amount of intangible fixed assets (limited to those relating to goodwill, including goodwill equivalent differences (meaning differences relating to entities that are other financial institutions, etc. (meaning other financial institutions, etc. as provided in Article 8, paragraph (6), item (i)) and that are either insurance subsidiary companies, etc. that are consolidated subsidiaries (meaning consolidated subsidiaries as provided in Article 2, item (iv) of the Consolidated Financial Statement Regulation; the same applies in this (1)) or persons to which the equity method (meaning the equity method as provided in item (viii) of the same Article; the same applies in this (1) and Article 9, paragraph (1)) applies — in the case of insurance subsidiary companies, etc. that are consolidated subsidiaries, amounts displayed included in goodwill pursuant to Article 28, paragraph (5) of the Consolidated Financial Statement Regulation, and in the case of persons to which the equity method applies, amounts equivalent thereto; the same applies in Article 10, paragraph (2), item (vi))). (2) The amount of intangible fixed assets (excluding those relating to goodwill and mortgage servicing rights). (b) The amount of deferred tax assets (excluding those relating to temporary differences). (c) The amount of deferred hedge gains and losses (meaning deferred hedge gains and losses as provided in Article 43-2, paragraph (1), item (ii) of the Consolidated Financial Statement Regulation, excluding gains and losses or fair value differences relating to hedging instruments where the fair value difference attributable to the hedged item is recognized as an item of accumulated other comprehensive income under paragraph (1), item (ii) of the preceding paragraph). (d) In the case of an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach, the amount obtained by deducting the total amount of eligible allowances from the total amount of expected loss amounts (meaning expected loss amounts as provided in Article 126; the same applies in this Chapter) relating to exposures to corporates, etc. and retail exposures, where such total exceeds the total eligible allowances. (e) The amount equivalent to increases in equity capital accompanying securitization transactions. (f) The amount of fair value differences arising from fair value measurement of liabilities (limited to those based on changes in the credit risk of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company or consolidated subsidiary legal entities) that are recognized as equity capital. (g) The amount of assets relating to retirement benefits. (ii) The amount of self-held common shares. (iii) The amount of common shares of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally. (iv) The amount of common shares of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. (v) The amount exceeding the 10% threshold relating to specific items. (vi) The amount exceeding the 15% threshold relating to specific items. (vii) The amount of Additional Tier 1 Capital shortfall.

children.text_ja: 第一項の「普通株式」とは、次に掲げる要件の全てを満たす株式をいう。一残余財産の分配について、最も劣後するものであること。二残余財産の分配について、一定額又は上限額が定められておらず、他の優先的内容を有する資本調達手段に対する分配が行われた後に、株主の保有する株式の数に応じて公平に割当てを受けるものであること。三償還期限が定められておらず、かつ、法令に基づく場合を除き、償還されるものでないこと。四発行者が発行時に将来にわたり買戻しを行う期待を生じさせておらず、かつ、当該期待を生じさせる内容が定められていないこと。五剰余金の配当が法令の規定に基づき算定された分配可能額を超えない範囲内で行われ、その額が株式の払込金額を基礎として算定されるものでなく、かつ、分配可能額に関する法令の規定により制限される場合を除き、剰余金の配当について上限額が定められていないこと。六剰余金の配当について、発行者の完全な裁量により決定することができ、これを行わないことが発行者の債務不履行となるものでないこと。七剰余金の配当について、他の資本調達手段に対して優先的内容を有するものでないこと。八他の資本調達手段に先立ち、発行者が業務を継続しながら、当該発行者に生じる損失を公平に負担するものであること。九発行者の倒産手続(破産手続、再生手続、更生手続又は特別清算手続をいう。以下同じ。)に関し当該発行者が債務超過(債務者が、その債務につき、その財産をもって完済することができない状態をいう。以下同じ。)にあるかどうかを判断するに当たり、当該発行者の債務として認識されるものでないこと。十払込金額が適用される企業会計の基準において株主資本として計上されるものであること。十一発行者により現に発行され、払込済みであり、かつ、取得に必要な資金が発行者により直接又は間接に融通されたものでないこと。十二担保権により担保されておらず、かつ、発行者又は当該発行者と密接な関係を有する者による保証に係る特約その他の法的又は経済的に他の資本調達手段に対して優先的内容を有するものとするための特約が定められていないこと。十三株主総会、取締役会その他の法令に基づく権限を有する機関の決議又は決定に基づき発行されたものであること。十四発行者の事業年度に係る説明書類において他の資本調達手段と明確に区別して記載されるものであること。
children.text_en: The "common shares" referred to in paragraph (1) means shares satisfying all of the following requirements. (i) That they are the most subordinated with respect to distribution of residual assets. (ii) That with respect to distribution of residual assets, no fixed amount or maximum amount is stipulated, and that they receive a fair allocation proportional to the number of shares held by the shareholders, after distributions are made to capital instruments having preferential terms. (iii) That they have no maturity date, and are not subject to redemption except in cases based on laws and regulations. (iv) That the issuer has not created any expectation of future repurchase at the time of issuance, and that no terms creating such expectation have been established. (v) That dividends on retained earnings are paid within the range not exceeding the distributable amount calculated pursuant to the provisions of laws and regulations, that the amount thereof is not calculated based on the paid-in amount of shares, and that, except where restricted by the provisions of laws and regulations concerning the distributable amount, no maximum amount is stipulated for dividends on retained earnings. (vi) That the decision to pay dividends on retained earnings can be made at the complete discretion of the issuer, and that refraining from such payment does not constitute a default by the issuer. (vii) That with respect to dividends on retained earnings, they are not preferential relative to other capital instruments. (viii) That, prior to other capital instruments, the issuer bears losses arising to the issuer on a fair basis while continuing operations. (ix) That they are not recognized as liabilities of the issuer in determining whether the issuer is insolvent (meaning a state in which a debtor is unable to fully repay its debts with its assets; the same applies hereinafter) in connection with insolvency proceedings (meaning bankruptcy proceedings, rehabilitation proceedings, reorganization proceedings, or special liquidation proceedings; the same applies hereinafter) of the issuer. (x) That the paid-in amount is accounted for as shareholders' equity under the applicable corporate accounting standards. (xi) That they are currently issued by the issuer, fully paid-in, and that the funds necessary for their acquisition have not been provided, directly or indirectly, by the issuer. (xii) That they are not secured by collateral, and that no terms have been established, whether by the issuer or a person with close ties to the issuer, by way of guarantee or otherwise, that would legally or economically make them preferential over other capital instruments. (xiii) That they have been issued based on a resolution or decision of the general meeting of shareholders, the board of directors, or other body having authority pursuant to laws and regulations. (xiv) That they are clearly distinguished from other capital instruments in the explanatory documents pertaining to the issuer's business year.

children.text_ja: 発行者に生じる損失を完全に負担することとなる場合は、この限りでない。
children.text_en: The "Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments" referred to in paragraph (1) and the preceding paragraph means capital instruments (excluding those qualifying as common shares (meaning common shares as provided in paragraph (3) of the preceding Article; the same applies in this Chapter)) satisfying all of the following requirements. (i) That they are currently issued by the issuer and fully paid-in. (ii) That with respect to distribution of residual assets or repayment or modification of obligations in insolvency proceedings, they are subordinated to other obligations of the issuer (including obligations qualifying as Tier 2 Capital instruments, but excluding obligations qualifying as Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments). (iii) That they are not secured by collateral and no terms have been established, whether by the issuer or a person with close ties to the issuer, by way of guarantee or otherwise, that would legally or economically make them preferential over other capital instruments of the same rank. (iv) That they have no maturity date and no terms are established concerning step-up rates, etc. (meaning a fixed interest rate or dividend rate added after a predetermined period has elapsed; hereinafter referred to as "step-up rates, etc.") or any other terms that increase the likelihood of redemption. (v) That where redemption is to be made, it may be made only at the option of the issuer after the date on which five years have elapsed since issuance (or, where there are recognized unavoidable reasons for redemption in light of the purpose of issuance, after issuance), and that all of the following requirements relating to redemption or repurchase are satisfied. (a) That prior confirmation of capital adequacy from the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency is required at the time of redemption or repurchase. (b) That the issuer has not taken any action that creates an expectation of redemption or repurchase. (c) That either of the following conditions is satisfied: (1) Where redemption or repurchase is made, capital raising for the purpose of such redemption or repurchase (limited to that ensuring quality equal to or higher than what is being redeemed or repurchased) is carried out prior to or at the time of such redemption or repurchase under conditions recognized as appropriate in light of the issuer's profitability. (2) Even after the redemption or repurchase, it is expected that the issuer will maintain a sufficient level of the Minimum Required Consolidated Capital Adequacy Ratios. (vi) That the issuer does not assume that the confirmation under item (v)(a) will be obtained, and that the issuer has not taken any action that creates an expectation regarding such confirmation. (vii) That with respect to suspension of dividend payments on retained earnings or interest payments, all of the following requirements are satisfied. (a) That suspension of dividend payments on retained earnings or interest payments can always be determined at the complete discretion of the issuer. (b) That determining to suspend dividend payments on retained earnings or interest payments does not constitute a default by the issuer. (c) That funds that did not flow out as a result of suspension of dividend payments on retained earnings or interest payments are fully available to the issuer. (d) That there are no restrictions whatsoever on the issuer in the event of suspension of dividend payments on retained earnings or interest payments (excluding those relating to dividend payments and interest payments on capital instruments of equal or higher quality). (viii) That dividend payments on retained earnings or interest payments are made within the range not exceeding the distributable amount calculated pursuant to the provisions of laws and regulations. (ix) That the amount of dividend payments on retained earnings or interest payments is not calculated based on the issuer's creditworthiness after issuance. (x) That they are not recognized as liabilities of the issuer in determining whether the issuer is insolvent in connection with insolvency proceedings of the issuer. (xi) That in the case of debt-type capital instruments, terms are established providing for write-down or conversion into common shares of the amount necessary for the Consolidated Common Equity Tier 1 Ratio in the formula of Article 2, item (i) to exceed a certain level when it falls below that level, or write-down or conversion of the entire principal (hereinafter referred to as "write-down or conversion of principal, etc."), or other similar terms. (xii) That they have not been acquired by the issuer or its subsidiary legal entities, etc., and that the funds necessary for their acquisition have not been provided, directly or indirectly, by the issuer. (xiii) That no terms are established providing for compensation where other capital instruments are issued on favorable terms with respect to issuance price during a certain period, or any other terms that impede the strengthening of the issuer's capital. (xiv) That in the case of capital instruments issued by special purpose companies, etc., the capital instruments issued to utilize the proceeds satisfy all of the requirements set forth in the preceding items and the following item, and that the issuer of such capital instruments has the entire proceeds immediately and unconditionally available. (xv) That where it is recognized that the issuer cannot survive without write-down or conversion of principal, etc. or financial assistance by public authorities or similar measures, and it is recognized that such measures need to be taken, terms are established providing that write-down or conversion of principal, etc. will be made; provided, however, that this shall not apply where, pursuant to the provisions of laws and regulations, measures to carry out write-down or conversion of principal, etc. are taken, or where the issuer fully bears the losses arising to the issuer prior to the provision of financial assistance by public authorities or similar measures.

clauses_ja.text: 第一項及び前項の「その他Tier1資本調達手段」とは、次に掲げる要件の全てを満たす資本調達手段
(普通株式(前条第三項に規定する普通株式をいう。以下この章において同じ。)に該当するものを除く。)
をいう。
一発行者により現に発行され、かつ、払込済みのものであること。
二残余財産の分配又は倒産処理手続における債務の弁済若しくは内容の変更について、発行者の他の債務
(Tier2資本調達手段に該当する債務を含み、その他Tier1資本調達手段に該当する債務を除く。)
に対して劣後的内容を有するものであること。
三担保権により担保されておらず、かつ、発行者又は当該発行者と密接な関係を有する者による保証に係る特約その他の法的又は経済的に他の同順位の資本調達手段に対して優先的内容を有するものとするための特約が定められていないこと。
四償還期限が定められておらず、あらかじめ定めた期間が経過した後に上乗せされる一定の金利又は配当率
(以下「ステップ・アップ金利等」という。)
に係る特約その他の償還を行う蓋然性を高める特約が定められていないこと。
五償還を行う場合には、発行後五年を経過した日以後
(発行の目的に照らして償還を行うことについてやむを得ない事由があると認められる場合にあっては、発行後)
に発行者の任意によるときに限り償還を行うことが可能であり、かつ、償還又は買戻しに関する次に掲げる要件の全てを満たすものであること。
イ償還又は買戻しに際し、自己資本の充実について、あらかじめ金融庁長官の確認を受けるものとなっていること。
ロ償還又は買戻しについて期待を生じさせる行為を発行者が行っていないこと。
ハその他次に掲げる要件のいずれかを満たすこと。
償還又は買戻しが行われる場合には、発行者の収益性に照らして適切と認められる条件により、当該償還又は買戻しのための資本調達
(当該償還又は買戻しが行われるものと同等以上の質が確保されるものに限る。)
が当該償還又は買戻しの時以前に行われること。
償還又は買戻しの後においても発行者が十分な水準の最低所要連結自己資本規制比率を維持することが見込まれること。
六発行者が前号イの確認が得られることを前提としておらず、当該発行者により当該確認について期待を生じさせる行為が行われていないこと。
七剰余金の配当又は利息の支払の停止について、次に掲げる要件の全てを満たすものであること。
イ剰余金の配当又は利息の支払の停止を発行者の完全な裁量により常に決定することができること。
ロ剰余金の配当又は利息の支払の停止を決定することが発行者の債務不履行とならないこと。
ハ剰余金の配当又は利息の支払の停止により流出しなかった資金を発行者が完全に利用可能であること。
ニ剰余金の配当又は利息の支払の停止を行った場合における発行者に対する一切の制約
(同等以上の質の資本調達手段に係る剰余金の配当及び利息の支払に関するものを除く。)
がないこと。
八剰余金の配当又は利息の支払が、法令の規定に基づき算定された分配可能額を超えない範囲内で行われるものであること。
九剰余金の配当額又は利息の支払額が、発行後の発行者の信用状態を基礎として算定されるものでないこと。
十発行者の倒産手続に関し当該発行者が債務超過にあるかどうかを判断するに当たり、当該発行者の債務として認識されるものでないこと。
十一負債性資本調達手段である場合には、第二条第一号の算式における連結普通株式等Tier1比率が一定の水準を下回ったときに連結普通株式等Tier1比率が当該水準を上回るために必要な額又はその全額の元本の削減又は普通株式への転換
(以下「元本の削減等」という。)
が行われる特約その他これに類する特約が定められていること。
十二発行者又は当該発行者の子法人等により取得されておらず、かつ、取得に必要な資金が発行者により直接又は間接に融通されたものでないこと。
十三ある特定の期間において他の資本調達手段が発行価格に関して有利な条件で発行された場合には補償が行われる特約その他の発行者の資本の増強を妨げる特約が定められていないこと。
十四特別目的会社等が発行する資本調達手段である場合には、発行代り金を利用するために発行される資本調達手段が前各号及び次号に掲げる要件の全てを満たし、かつ、当該資本調達手段の発行者が発行代り金の全額を即時かつ無制限に利用可能であること。
十五元本の削減等又は公的機関による資金の援助その他これに類する措置が講ぜられなければ発行者が存続できないと認められる場合において、これらの措置が講ぜられる必要があると認められるときは、元本の削減等が行われる旨の特約が定められていること。
ただし、法令の規定に基づいて、元本の削減等を行う措置が講ぜられる場合又は公的機関による資金の援助その他これに類する措置が講ぜられる前に当該発行者に生じる損失を完全に負担することとなる場合は、この限りでない。

children.text_ja: 第二条第三号の算式において、Tier2資本に係る基礎項目の額は、次に掲げる額の合計額とする。ただし、Tier2資本調達手段のうち償還期限の定めがあり、かつ、当該償還期限までの期間が五年以内になったものについては、連結貸借対照表計上額に、算出基準日から当該償還期限までの期間の日数を当該償還期限までの期間が五年になった日から当該償還期限までの期間の日数で除して得た割合を乗じて得た額とする。一Tier2資本調達手段に係る株主資本の額(社外流出予定額を除く。)二Tier2資本調達手段に係る負債の額二の二Tier2資本調達手段に係る株式引受権の額三Tier2資本調達手段に係る新株予約権の額四特別目的会社等の発行するTier2資本調達手段の額五Tier2資本に係る調整後非支配株主持分等の額六次に掲げる額の合計額イ一般貸倒引当金(内部格付手法採用最終指定親会社においては第百二十七条の規定により標準的手法により算出される信用リスク・アセットの額に対応するものとして区分された一般貸倒引当金及び証券化エクスポージャーに係る一般貸倒引当金に限る。)の額(当該額が第二条各号の算式における信用リスク・アセットの額の合計額(内部格付手法採用最終指定親会社にあっては、第百二十八条第二号に掲げる額及び証券化エクスポージャーに係る信用リスク・アセットの額の合計額とする。)に一・二五パーセントを乗じて得た額を上回る場合にあっては、当該乗じて得た額とする。)ロ内部格付手法採用最終指定親会社において、適格引当金の合計額が事業法人等向けエクスポージャー及びリテール向けエクスポージャーの期待損失額の合計額を上回る場合における当該適格引当金の合計額から当該期待損失額の合計額を控除した額(当該額が第百二十八条第一号に掲げる額に〇・六パーセントを乗じて得た額を上回る場合にあっては、当該乗じて得た額とする。)
children.text_en: In the formula of Article 2, item (iii), the amount of basic items relating to Tier 2 Capital shall be the sum of the following amounts; provided, however, that with respect to Tier 2 Capital instruments that have a maturity date and whose remaining period until such maturity date has become five years or less, the amount shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the amount recorded on the consolidated balance sheet by the ratio obtained by dividing the number of days in the period from the calculation reference date to such maturity date by the number of days in the period from the date on which five years remained until such maturity date to such maturity date. (i) The amount of shareholders' equity relating to Tier 2 Capital instruments (excluding planned external outflows). (ii) The amount of liabilities relating to Tier 2 Capital instruments. (ii-2) The amount of share subscription rights relating to Tier 2 Capital instruments. (iii) The amount of share options relating to Tier 2 Capital instruments. (iv) The amount of Tier 2 Capital instruments issued by special purpose companies, etc. (v) The amount of adjusted minority interests, etc. relating to Tier 2 Capital. (vi) The sum of the following amounts: (a) The amount of general allowances for loan losses (in the case of an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach, limited to general allowances for loan losses allocated as corresponding to credit risk-weighted asset amounts calculated using the standardized approach pursuant to Article 127, and general allowances for loan losses relating to securitization exposures) (where such amount exceeds the amount obtained by multiplying the total amount of credit risk-weighted assets in the formula of Article 2, each item (in the case of an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach, the total of the amount set forth in Article 128, item (ii) and the total amount of credit risk-weighted assets relating to securitization exposures) by 1.25%, such multiplied amount shall apply). (b) In the case of an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach, the amount obtained by deducting the total amount of expected loss amounts relating to exposures to corporates, etc. and retail exposures from the total amount of eligible allowances, where such total eligible allowances exceed such total expected loss amounts (where such amount exceeds the amount obtained by multiplying the amount set forth in Article 128, item (i) by 0.6%, such multiplied amount shall apply).

children.text_ja: 第二条第三号の算式において、Tier2資本に係る調整項目の額は、次に掲げる額の合計額とする。一自己保有Tier2資本調達手段の額二意図的に保有している他の金融機関等のTier2資本調達手段の額三少数出資金融機関等のTier2資本調達手段の額四その他金融機関等のTier2資本調達手段の額五少数出資金融機関等のその他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額(特例外部TLAC調達手段にあっては、当該特例外部TLAC調達手段を発行する者(以下この号において「発行者」という。)が当該特例外部TLAC調達手段の額のうち自己のその他外部TLAC調達手段に相当するものに算入している額が当該発行者の特例外部TLAC調達手段の額の合計額に占める割合を、最終指定親会社等が保有している当該発行者の特例外部TLAC調達手段の額に乗じて得られた額とする。以下この条及び第八条において同じ。)六その他金融機関等のその他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額
children.text_en: In the formula of Article 2, item (iii), the amount of adjustment items relating to Tier 2 Capital shall be the sum of the following amounts. (i) The amount of self-held Tier 2 Capital instruments. (ii) The amount of Tier 2 Capital instruments of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally. (iii) The amount of Tier 2 Capital instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. (iv) The amount of Tier 2 Capital instruments of other financial institutions, etc. (v) The amount of other external TLAC-related instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. (in the case of special external TLAC instruments, the amount obtained by multiplying the amount held by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. of the special external TLAC instruments of the issuer (hereinafter referred to as the "issuer" in this item) of such special external TLAC instruments by the ratio of the amount included in the issuer's own other external TLAC instruments equivalent amounts out of the total amount of such special external TLAC instruments to the total amount of the issuer's special external TLAC instruments; the same applies hereinafter in this Article and Article 8). (vi) The amount of other external TLAC-related instruments of other financial institutions, etc.

三少数出資金融機関等のTier2資本調達手段の額

children.text_ja: 前項の規定にかかわらず、TLAC規制対象最終指定親会社については、第二条第三号の算式におけるTier2資本に係る調整項目の額は、前項各号に掲げる額の合計額に、次に掲げる額(前項各号に該当する額を除く。)の合計額を加えた額とする。一意図的に保有している他の金融機関等のその他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額二最終指定親会社等が保有し、かつ、次に掲げる要件の全てを満たす少数出資金融機関等のその他外部TLAC関連調達手段で、最終指定親会社が第八条第七項の規定により少数出資に係る対象資本等調達手段合計額を算出するに当たり、その他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額の合計額から控除するものとして指定しているもの(次号及び同項第一号において「マーケット・メイク目的保有TLAC」という。)のうち、保有中に次に掲げる要件のいずれかを欠くに至ったものの額イ当該最終指定親会社等のトレーディング商品(連結貸借対照表の科目のトレーディング商品をいう。第十一条の三及び第七章において同じ。)に含まれること。ロ保有期間が三十営業日以内であること。三マーケット・メイク目的保有TLACの額の合計額から、前号に掲げる額及び少数出資に係る五パーセント基準額(第八条第七項第一号に規定する少数出資に係る五パーセント基準額をいう。)の合計額を控除した額(当該額が零を下回る場合にあっては、零とする。)
children.text_en: Notwithstanding the preceding paragraph, with respect to TLAC-regulated Ultimate Designated Parent Companies, the amount of adjustment items relating to Tier 2 Capital in the formula of Article 2, item (iii) shall be the amount obtained by adding to the sum of the amounts set forth in each item of the preceding paragraph the sum of the following amounts (excluding amounts falling under each item of the preceding paragraph). (i) The amount of other external TLAC-related instruments of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally. (ii) The amount of other external TLAC-related instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. that are held by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. and that are designated by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company as those to be deducted from the total amount of other external TLAC-related instruments in calculating the total amount of target capital instruments, etc. relating to minority investments pursuant to Article 8, paragraph (7), and that satisfy all of the following requirements (hereinafter referred to as "market-making TLAC" in the following item and item (i) of the same paragraph), where such instruments have ceased to satisfy either of the following requirements during the holding period. (a) That they are included in trading instruments (meaning trading instruments as an account item on the consolidated balance sheet; the same applies in Article 11-3 and Chapter VII) of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. (b) That the holding period is within thirty business days. (iii) The amount obtained by deducting from the total amount of market-making TLAC the sum of the amount set forth in the preceding item and the 5% threshold amount relating to minority investments (meaning the 5% threshold amount relating to minority investments as provided in Article 8, paragraph (7), item (i)) (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero).

clauses_ja.text: 前項の規定にかかわらず、TLAC規制対象最終指定親会社については、第二条第三号の算式におけるTier2資本に係る調整項目の額は、前項各号に掲げる額の合計額に、次に掲げる額
(前項各号に該当する額を除く。)
の合計額を加えた額とする。
一意図的に保有している他の金融機関等のその他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額
二最終指定親会社等が保有し、かつ、次に掲げる要件の全てを満たす少数出資金融機関等のその他外部TLAC関連調達手段で、最終指定親会社が第八条第七項の規定により少数出資に係る対象資本等調達手段合計額を算出するに当たり、その他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額の合計額から控除するものとして指定しているもの
(次号及び同項第一号において「マーケット・メイク目的保有TLAC」という。)
のうち、保有中に次に掲げる要件のいずれかを欠くに至ったものの額イ当該最終指定親会社等のトレーディング商品
(連結貸借対照表の科目のトレーディング商品をいう。第十一条の三及び第七章において同じ。)
に含まれること。ロ保有期間が三十営業日以内であること。
三マーケット・メイク目的保有TLACの額の合計額から、前号に掲げる額及び少数出資に係る五パーセント基準額
(第八条第七項第一号に規定する少数出資に係る五パーセント基準額をいう。)
の合計額を控除した額
(当該額が零を下回る場合にあっては、零とする。)

clauses_en.text: Notwithstanding the preceding paragraph, with respect to TLAC-regulated Ultimate Designated Parent Companies, the amount of adjustment items relating to Tier 2 Capital in the formula of Article 2, item (iii) shall be the amount obtained by adding to the sum of the amounts set forth in each item of the preceding paragraph the sum of the following amounts
(excluding amounts falling under each item of the preceding paragraph)
(i) The amount of other external TLAC-related instruments of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally.

(ii) The amount of other external TLAC-related instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. that are held by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. and that are designated by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company as those to be deducted from the total amount of other external TLAC-related instruments in calculating the total amount of target capital instruments, etc. relating to minority investments pursuant to Article 8, paragraph (7), and that satisfy all of the following requirements (hereinafter referred to as "market-making TLAC" in the following item and item (i) of the same paragraph), where such instruments have ceased to satisfy either of the following requirements during the holding period. (a) That they are included in trading instruments (meaning trading instruments as an account item on the consolidated balance sheet; the same applies in Article 11-3 and Chapter VII) of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. (b) That the holding period is within thirty business days.

(iii) The amount obtained by deducting from the total amount of market-making TLAC the sum of the amount set forth in the preceding item and the 5% threshold amount relating to minority investments (meaning the 5% threshold amount relating to minority investments as provided in Article 8, paragraph (7), item (i)) (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero).

refs.text_en: each item of the preceding paragraph

defined_terms.term_ja: マーケット・メイク目的保有TLAC

children.text_ja: 第一項第四号に掲げる特別目的会社等の発行するTier2資本調達手段の額は、特別目的会社等の資本調達手段のうち、次に掲げる要件の全てを満たすもの(前条第三項各号に掲げる要件の全てを満たすものを除く。)の額とする。一当該特別目的会社等の発行する資本調達手段がその他Tier1資本調達手段(前条第四項に規定するその他Tier1資本調達手段をいう。以下この章において同じ。)又はTier2資本調達手段に該当するものであること。二当該特別目的会社等の発行する資本調達手段の発行代り金の全額を当該特別目的会社等の親会社等である最終指定親会社が即時かつ無制限に利用可能であること。三前号の発行代り金を利用するために発行される資本調達手段がその他Tier1資本調達手段又はTier2資本調達手段に該当するものであること。四当該特別目的会社等の親会社等である最終指定親会社がその総株主等の議決権の全てを保有すること。
children.text_en: The amount of Tier 2 Capital instruments issued by special purpose companies, etc. set forth in paragraph (1), item (iv) shall be the amount of capital instruments of special purpose companies, etc. that satisfy all of the following requirements (excluding those that satisfy all of the requirements of each item of paragraph (3) of the preceding Article). (i) That the capital instruments issued by such special purpose company, etc. qualify as Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments (meaning Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments as provided in paragraph (4) of the preceding Article; the same applies hereinafter in this Chapter) or Tier 2 Capital instruments. (ii) That the entire proceeds from the issuance of capital instruments issued by such special purpose company, etc. are immediately and unconditionally available to the Ultimate Designated Parent Company that is the parent company, etc. of such special purpose company, etc. (iii) That the capital instruments issued to utilize the proceeds set forth in the preceding item qualify as Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments or Tier 2 Capital instruments. (iv) That the Ultimate Designated Parent Company that is the parent company, etc. of such special purpose company, etc. holds all of the voting rights of all shareholders, etc. of such special purpose company, etc.

clauses_ja.text: 第一項第四号に掲げる特別目的会社等の発行するTier2資本調達手段の額は、特別目的会社等の資本調達手段のうち、次に掲げる要件の全てを満たすもの
(前条第三項各号に掲げる要件の全てを満たすものを除く。)
の額とする。
一当該特別目的会社等の発行する資本調達手段がその他Tier1資本調達手段
(前条第四項に規定するその他Tier1資本調達手段をいう。以下この章において同じ。)
又はTier2資本調達手段に該当するものであること。
二当該特別目的会社等の発行する資本調達手段の発行代り金の全額を当該特別目的会社等の親会社等である最終指定親会社が即時かつ無制限に利用可能であること。
三前号の発行代り金を利用するために発行される資本調達手段がその他Tier1資本調達手段又はTier2資本調達手段に該当するものであること。
四当該特別目的会社等の親会社等である最終指定親会社がその総株主等の議決権の全てを保有すること。

clauses_en.text: The amount of Tier 2 Capital instruments issued by special purpose companies, etc. set forth in paragraph (1), item (iv) shall be the amount of capital instruments of special purpose companies, etc. that satisfy all of the following requirements
(excluding those that satisfy all of the requirements of each item of paragraph (3) of the preceding Article)

(i) That the capital instruments issued by such special purpose company, etc. qualify as Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments (meaning Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments as provided in paragraph (4) of the preceding Article; the same applies hereinafter in this Chapter) or Tier 2 Capital instruments.

(ii) That the entire proceeds from the issuance of capital instruments issued by such special purpose company, etc. are immediately and unconditionally available to the Ultimate Designated Parent Company that is the parent company, etc. of such special purpose company, etc.
(iii) That the capital instruments issued to utilize the proceeds set forth in the preceding item qualify as Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments or Tier 2 Capital instruments.

(iv) That the Ultimate Designated Parent Company that is the parent company, etc. of such special purpose company, etc. holds all of the voting rights of all shareholders, etc. of such special purpose company, etc.

children.text_en: "Tier 2 Capital instruments" as referred to in paragraph (1) and the preceding paragraph means capital instruments (excluding those that qualify as common shares or Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments) that satisfy all of the following requirements. (i) That they have been actually issued by the issuer and are fully paid up. (ii) That with respect to distribution of residual assets or repayment or modification of obligations in insolvency proceedings, they are subordinated to the issuer's other obligations (excluding obligations that qualify as Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments or Tier 2 Capital instruments). (iii) That they are not secured by collateral, and that there are no special provisions for guarantees by the issuer or persons in close relationship with the issuer or other provisions that are legally or economically designed to give priority over other instruments of the same rank. (iv) That, where a maturity date is specified, the period from issuance to maturity is five years or more, and that there are no provisions relating to step-up interest rates, etc. or other provisions that increase the probability of redemption, etc. (meaning redemption of instruments with no maturity date or early redemption of instruments with a specified maturity date; the same applies in the following item). (v) That, where redemption, etc. is carried out, redemption, etc. may only be carried out at the issuer's option on or after the date on which five years have elapsed from the date of issuance (or after issuance if there are unavoidable reasons for redemption, etc. in light of the purpose of issuance), and that all of the following requirements relating to redemption, etc. or buyback are satisfied. (a) That prior confirmation from the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency regarding capital adequacy is obtained at the time of redemption, etc. or buyback. (b) That the issuer has not taken any action that creates an expectation of redemption, etc. or buyback. (c) That either of the following requirements is satisfied: (1) In the case where redemption, etc. or buyback is carried out, capital raising for such redemption, etc. or buyback (limited to that which ensures quality at least equivalent to the instrument being redeemed, etc. or bought back) has been conducted prior to or at the time of such redemption, etc. or buyback, under conditions that are appropriate in light of the issuer's profitability. (2) That it is expected that the issuer will maintain a sufficient level of the minimum required consolidated capital adequacy ratio even after the redemption, etc. or buyback. (vi) That there are no provisions for acceleration of payment obligations in the event the issuer fails to perform its obligations. (vii) That the dividend amount or interest payment amount is not calculated based on the issuer's credit standing after issuance. (viii) That they have not been acquired by the issuer or a subsidiary of the issuer, and that the funds necessary for acquisition have not been directly or indirectly provided by the issuer. (ix) In the case of capital instruments issued by special purpose companies, etc., that the capital instruments issued to utilize the proceeds satisfy all of the requirements of the preceding items and the following item or all of the requirements of each item of paragraph (4) of the preceding Article, and that the issuer of such capital instruments may immediately and unconditionally use the entire proceeds. (x) That, where it is recognized that the issuer cannot continue to exist without write-down, etc. or public financial support or similar measures, and it is recognized that such measures need to be taken, provisions stipulating that write-down, etc. will be carried out are established; provided, however, that this shall not apply where, pursuant to the provisions of laws and regulations, measures to carry out write-down, etc. will be taken, or where the issuer will bear the full losses arising before public financial support or similar measures are provided.

children.text_en: In the formula of Article 2-2, paragraph (1), the amount of Common Equity Tier 1 Capital relating to the capital buffer shall be the amount obtained by deducting the amounts set forth in items (ii) and (iii) from the amount set forth in item (i). (i) The amount obtained by deducting from the amount of Common Equity Tier 1 Capital (meaning the amount of Common Equity Tier 1 Capital in the formula of Article 2, item (i)) the amount obtained by multiplying the total of the following amounts (hereinafter referred to as "risk-weighted assets amount" in this Article) by 4.5% (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero). (ii) The amount obtained by deducting the amount of Additional Tier 1 Capital (meaning the amount of Additional Tier 1 Capital in the formula of Article 2, item (ii); the same applies in item (b) of the following item) from the amount obtained by multiplying the risk-weighted assets amount by 1.5% (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero). (iii) The amount obtained by deducting the sum of the following amounts from the amount obtained by multiplying the risk-weighted assets amount by 2% (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero). (a) The amount of Tier 2 Capital (meaning the amount of Tier 2 Capital in the formula of Article 2, item (iii)). (b) The amount obtained by deducting from the amount of Additional Tier 1 Capital the amount obtained by multiplying the risk-weighted assets amount by 1.5% (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero).

children.text_ja: 前項の規定にかかわらず、TLAC規制対象最終指定親会社については、第二条の二第一項の算式における資本バッファーに係る普通株式等Tier1資本の額は、第一号に掲げる額から第二号に掲げる額を控除した額とする。ただし、第三条の規定にかかわらず、第二号に掲げる額の算出に当たっては、最終指定親会社TLAC告示第一条第九号に規定する国内処理対象最終指定親会社グループに含まれる子法人等に限り、連結の範囲に含めるものとする。一前項第一号に掲げる額から前項第二号及び第三号に掲げる額を控除した額(当該額が零を下回る場合にあっては、零とする。)二リスク・アセットの額に最低所要リスク・アセットベースTLAC比率(最終指定親会社TLAC告示第一条第十号に規定する最低所要リスク・アセットベースTLAC比率をいう。)から八パーセント(最終指定親会社TLAC告示第二条第二項の規定を適用する場合にあっては、十一・五パーセント)を控除して得た比率を乗じて得た額から次に掲げる額の合計額を控除した額(当該額が零を下回る場合にあっては、零とする。)イその他外部TLAC調達手段の額(最終指定親会社TLAC告示第四条第一項第九号に掲げる額から同条第二項第四号及び第五号に掲げる額の合計額を控除した額をいう。)ロその他Tier1資本の額(最終指定親会社TLAC告示第四条第一項第二号から第四号までに掲げる額の合計額から同条第二項第二号に掲げる額を控除した額をいう。(2)において同じ。)から次に掲げる額の合計額を控除した額(当該額が零を下回る場合にあっては、零とする。)(１)リスク・アセットの額に一・五パーセントを乗じて得た額(２)その他Tier1資本の額がリスク・アセットの額に一・五パーセントを乗じて得た額を上回る場合にあっては、リスク・アセットの額に二パーセントを乗じて得た額からTier2資本の額(最終指定親会社TLAC告示第四条第一項第五号から第八号までに掲げる額の合計額から同条第二項第三号に掲げる額を控除した額をいう。ハにおいて同じ。)を控除した額(当該額が零を下回る場合にあっては、零とする。)ハTier2資本の額からリスク・アセットの額に二パーセントを乗じて得た額を控除した額(当該額が零を下回る場合にあっては、零とする。)
children.text_en: Notwithstanding the preceding paragraph, with respect to TLAC-regulated Ultimate Designated Parent Companies, the amount of Common Equity Tier 1 Capital relating to the capital buffer in the formula of Article 2-2, paragraph (1) shall be the amount obtained by deducting the amount set forth in item (ii) from the amount set forth in item (i); provided, however, that notwithstanding Article 3, in calculating the amount set forth in item (ii), only subsidiaries included in the domestic resolution Ultimate Designated Parent Company group as provided in Article 1, item (ix) of the TLAC Public Notice for Ultimate Designated Parent Companies shall be included in the scope of consolidation. (i) The amount obtained by deducting the amounts set forth in items (ii) and (iii) of the preceding paragraph from the amount set forth in item (i) of the preceding paragraph (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero). (ii) The amount obtained by deducting the sum of the following amounts from the amount obtained by multiplying the risk-weighted assets amount by the ratio obtained by deducting 8% (11.5% in cases where the provisions of Article 2, paragraph (2) of the TLAC Public Notice for Ultimate Designated Parent Companies apply) from the minimum required risk-weighted assets-based TLAC ratio (meaning the minimum required risk-weighted assets-based TLAC ratio as provided in Article 1, item (x) of the TLAC Public Notice for Ultimate Designated Parent Companies) (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero). (a) The amount of other external TLAC instruments (meaning the amount obtained by deducting the sum of the amounts set forth in Article 4, paragraph (2), items (iv) and (v) of the TLAC Public Notice for Ultimate Designated Parent Companies from the amount set forth in Article 4, paragraph (1), item (ix) of such Public Notice). (b) The amount obtained by deducting the sum of the following amounts from the amount of Additional Tier 1 Capital (meaning the amount obtained by deducting the amount set forth in Article 4, paragraph (2), item (ii) of the TLAC Public Notice for Ultimate Designated Parent Companies from the sum of the amounts set forth in Article 4, paragraph (1), items (ii) through (iv) of such Public Notice; the same applies in (2)) (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero). (1) The amount obtained by multiplying the risk-weighted assets amount by 1.5%. (2) In cases where the amount of Additional Tier 1 Capital exceeds the amount obtained by multiplying the risk-weighted assets amount by 1.5%, the amount obtained by deducting the amount of Tier 2 Capital (meaning the amount obtained by deducting the amount set forth in Article 4, paragraph (2), item (iii) of the TLAC Public Notice for Ultimate Designated Parent Companies from the sum of the amounts set forth in Article 4, paragraph (1), items (v) through (viii) of such Public Notice; the same applies in (c)) from the amount obtained by multiplying the risk-weighted assets amount by 2% (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero). (c) The amount obtained by deducting from the amount of Tier 2 Capital the amount obtained by multiplying the risk-weighted assets amount by 2% (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero).

children.heading: 調整後非支配株主持分等の額及び調整項目の額の算出方法
children.summary_ja: 連結子会社の少数株主持分の算入上限、自己保有・意図的保有・少数出資・その他金融機関等が保有する資本調達手段の調整額の算出方法、ならびに特定項目の10%・15%閾値超過額の計算とショート・ポジション相殺・控除・繰延税金資産相殺・AT1・T2資本不足額の算定方法を包括的に規定する条文。
children.summary_en: Comprehensively governs the calculation of minority interest inclusion caps, adjustments for self-held, intentional, minority-invested, and other-FI capital instruments, 10%/15% threshold excess amounts for specified items, short position netting, exclusions, deferred tax asset netting, and AT1/T2 Capital shortfall amounts.

children.heading: 調整後非支配株主持分等の額及び調整項目の額の算出方法
children.text_ja: 第五条第一項第四号、第六条第一項第五号及び第七条第一項第五号に掲げる額は、次に定めるところにより算出した額とする。一第五条第一項第四号に掲げる普通株式等Tier1資本に係る調整後非支配株主持分の額は、特定連結子法人等(連結子法人等(特別目的会社等を除く。以下この条において同じ。)のうち金融機関又はバーゼル銀行監督委員会の定める自己資本比率の基準若しくはこれと類似の基準(法第四十六条の六に定める自己資本規制比率を含む。第三十一条において同じ。)の適用を受ける者をいう。以下この号において同じ。)の非支配株主持分相当普通株式等Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額(特定連結子法人等の単体普通株式等Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額(第二条第一号の算式の分子の額の算出方法における普通株式等Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額又はこれに相当する額をいう。以下この号において同じ。)のうち当該特定連結子法人等の最終指定親会社の連結貸借対照表の純資産の部に株式引受権、新株予約権又は非支配株主持分として計上される部分の額(当該額が零を下回る場合にあっては、零とする。)をいう。以下この号において同じ。)のうち次に掲げる額のいずれか少ない額に普通株式等Tier1資本に係る第三者持分割合(特定連結子法人等の非支配株主持分相当普通株式等Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額を単体普通株式等Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額で除して得た割合をいう。)を乗じて得た額以下の額とする。イ当該特定連結子法人等の第二条各号の算式の分母の額に相当する額に七パーセントを乗じて得た額ロ第二条各号の算式の分母の額のうち当該特定連結子法人等に関連するものの額(当該特定連結子法人等の同条各号の算式の分母の額に相当する額に関連するものの額をいう。)に七パーセントを乗じて得た額二第六条第一項第五号に掲げるその他Tier1資本に係る調整後非支配株主持分等の額は、連結子法人等の非支配株主持分等相当Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額(連結子法人等の単体Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額(第二条第一号の算式の分子の額の算出方法における普通株式等Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額及び同条第二号の算式の分子の額の算出方法におけるその他Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額の合計額又はこれに相当する額をいう。以下この項において同じ。)のうち当該連結子法人等の最終指定親会社の連結貸借対照表の純資産の部又は負債の部に株式引受権、新株予約権若しくは非支配株主持分又は負債として計上される部分の額(当該額が零を下回る場合にあっては、零とする。)をいう。以下この号において同じ。)のうち次に掲げる額のいずれか少ない額にTier1資本に係る第三者持分割合(連結子法人等の非支配株主持分等相当Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額を単体Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額で除して得た割合をいう。)を乗じて得た額以下の額から、第五条第一項第四号に掲げる額を控除した額とする。イ当該連結子法人等の第二条各号の算式の分母の額に相当する額に八・五パーセントを乗じて得た額ロ第二条各号の算式の分母の額のうち当該連結子法人等に関連するものの額(当該連結子法人等の同条各号の算式の分母の額に相当する額に関連するものの額をいう。)に八・五パーセントを乗じて得た額三第七条第一項第五号に掲げるTier2資本に係る調整後非支配株主持分等の額は、連結子法人等の非支配株主持分等相当総自己資本に係る基礎項目の額(連結子法人等の単体総自己資本に係る基礎項目の額(連結子法人等の単体Tier1資本に係る基礎項目の額及び第二条第三号の算式の分子の額の算出方法におけるTier2資本に係る基礎項目の額の合計額又はこれに相当する額をいう。以下この号において同じ。)のうち当該連結子法人等の最終指定親会社の連結貸借対照表の純資産の部又は負債の部に株式引受権、新株予約権若しくは非支配株主持分又は負債として計上される部分の額(当該額が零を下回る場合にあっては、零とする。)をいう。以下この号において同じ。)のうち次に掲げる額のいずれか少ない額に総自己資本に係る第三者持分割合(連結子法人等の非支配株主持分等相当総自己資本に係る基礎項目の額を単体総自己資本に係る基礎項目の額で除して得た割合をいう。)を乗じて得た額以下の額から、第五条第一項第四号及び第六条第一項第五号に掲げる額の合計額を控除した額とする。イ当該連結子法人等の第二条各号の算式の分母の額に相当する額に十・五パーセントを乗じて得た額ロ第二条各号の算式の分母の額のうち当該連結子法人等に関連するものの額(当該連結子法人等の同条各号の算式の分母の額に相当する額に関連するものの額をいう。)に十・五パーセントを乗じて得た額
children.text_en: The amounts set forth in Article 5, paragraph (1), item (iv), Article 6, paragraph (1), item (v), and Article 7, paragraph (1), item (v) shall be calculated as follows. (i) The amount of adjusted minority interests relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital set forth in Article 5, paragraph (1), item (iv) shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the lesser of the following amounts by the third-party interest ratio relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital (meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the amount of basic items relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital equivalent to minority interests of a specified consolidated subsidiary (meaning a consolidated subsidiary (excluding special purpose companies, etc.; the same applies hereinafter in this Article) that is a financial institution or is subject to capital adequacy ratio standards established by the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision or similar standards (including the capital adequacy ratio prescribed in Article 46-6 of the Act; the same applies in Article 31); the same applies hereinafter in this item) by the amount of basic items relating to standalone Common Equity Tier 1 Capital), with such result being the maximum allowable amount: the amount of basic items relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital equivalent to minority interests of a specified consolidated subsidiary (meaning the portion of the amount of basic items relating to standalone Common Equity Tier 1 Capital of the specified consolidated subsidiary (meaning the amount of basic items relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital in the method for calculating the numerator amount in the formula of Article 2, item (i), or an equivalent amount; the same applies hereinafter in this item) that is recorded in the net assets section of the consolidated balance sheet of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company of such specified consolidated subsidiary as share subscription rights, share options, or non-controlling interests (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero); the same applies hereinafter in this item). (a) The amount obtained by multiplying the amount equivalent to the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 of such specified consolidated subsidiary by 7%. (b) The amount obtained by multiplying the amount of the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 that is related to such specified consolidated subsidiary (meaning the amount related to the amount equivalent to the denominator of the formula of each item of such Article of such specified consolidated subsidiary) by 7%. (ii) The amount of adjusted minority interests, etc. relating to Additional Tier 1 Capital set forth in Article 6, paragraph (1), item (v) shall be the amount obtained by deducting the amount set forth in Article 5, paragraph (1), item (iv) from the amount obtained by multiplying the lesser of the following amounts by the third-party interest ratio relating to Tier 1 Capital (meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the amount of basic items relating to Tier 1 Capital equivalent to non-controlling interests, etc. of a consolidated subsidiary by the amount of basic items relating to standalone Tier 1 Capital), with such result being the maximum allowable amount: the amount of basic items relating to Tier 1 Capital equivalent to non-controlling interests, etc. of a consolidated subsidiary (meaning the portion of the amount of basic items relating to standalone Tier 1 Capital of the consolidated subsidiary (meaning the total of the amount of basic items relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital in the method for calculating the numerator amount in the formula of Article 2, item (i) and the amount of basic items relating to Additional Tier 1 Capital in the method for calculating the numerator amount in the formula of Article 2, item (ii), or an equivalent amount; the same applies hereinafter in this paragraph) that is recorded in the net assets section or liabilities section of the consolidated balance sheet of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company of such consolidated subsidiary as share subscription rights, share options, non-controlling interests, or liabilities (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero); the same applies hereinafter in this item). (a) The amount obtained by multiplying the amount equivalent to the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 of such consolidated subsidiary by 8.5%. (b) The amount obtained by multiplying the amount of the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 that is related to such consolidated subsidiary (meaning the amount related to the amount equivalent to the denominator of the formula of each item of such Article of such consolidated subsidiary) by 8.5%. (iii) The amount of adjusted minority interests, etc. relating to Tier 2 Capital set forth in Article 7, paragraph (1), item (v) shall be the amount obtained by deducting the sum of the amounts set forth in Article 5, paragraph (1), item (iv) and Article 6, paragraph (1), item (v) from the amount obtained by multiplying the lesser of the following amounts by the third-party interest ratio relating to total capital (meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the amount of basic items relating to total capital equivalent to non-controlling interests, etc. of a consolidated subsidiary by the amount of basic items relating to standalone total capital), with such result being the maximum allowable amount: the amount of basic items relating to total capital equivalent to non-controlling interests, etc. of a consolidated subsidiary (meaning the portion of the amount of basic items relating to standalone total capital of a consolidated subsidiary (meaning the total of the amount of basic items relating to standalone Tier 1 Capital of the consolidated subsidiary and the amount of basic items relating to Tier 2 Capital in the method for calculating the numerator amount in the formula of Article 2, item (iii), or an equivalent amount; the same applies hereinafter in this item) that is recorded in the net assets section or liabilities section of the consolidated balance sheet of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company of such consolidated subsidiary as share subscription rights, share options, non-controlling interests, or liabilities (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero); the same applies hereinafter in this item). (a) The amount obtained by multiplying the amount equivalent to the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 of such consolidated subsidiary by 10.5%. (b) The amount obtained by multiplying the amount of the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 that is related to such consolidated subsidiary (meaning the amount related to the amount equivalent to the denominator of the formula of each item of such Article of such consolidated subsidiary) by 10.5%.

clauses_en.text: The amounts set forth in Article 5, paragraph (1), item (iv), Article 6, paragraph (1), item (v), and Article 7, paragraph (1), item (v) shall be calculated as follows.

(i) The amount of adjusted minority interests relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital set forth in Article 5, paragraph (1), item (iv) shall be an amount not exceeding the amount obtained by multiplying the lesser of the following amounts by the third-party interest ratio relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital (meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the amount of basic items relating to CET1 equivalent to minority interests of the specified consolidated subsidiary by the amount of basic items relating to standalone CET1), using as the base the amount of basic items relating to CET1 equivalent to minority interests of specified consolidated subsidiaries (meaning those consolidated subsidiaries, excluding special purpose companies, etc., that are subject to capital ratio standards of the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision or similar standards including the capital adequacy ratio under Article 46-6 of the Act; the same applies hereinafter in this item), which is the portion of standalone CET1 basic items of the specified consolidated subsidiary recorded as share subscription rights, share options, or non-controlling interests in the net assets section of the consolidated balance sheet of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company of such subsidiary (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero). (a) The amount equivalent to the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 of such specified consolidated subsidiary multiplied by 7%. (b) The amount of the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 related to such specified consolidated subsidiary (meaning the portion related to the equivalent denominator of such subsidiary) multiplied by 7%.

(ii) The amount of adjusted minority interests, etc. relating to Additional Tier 1 Capital set forth in Article 6, paragraph (1), item (v) shall be the amount obtained by deducting the amount set forth in Article 5, paragraph (1), item (iv) from an amount not exceeding the amount obtained by multiplying the lesser of the following amounts by the third-party interest ratio relating to Tier 1 Capital (meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the amount of basic items relating to Tier 1 Capital equivalent to non-controlling interests, etc. of a consolidated subsidiary by the amount of standalone Tier 1 basic items), using as the base the amount of basic items relating to Tier 1 Capital equivalent to non-controlling interests, etc. of consolidated subsidiaries (meaning the portion of standalone Tier 1 Capital basic items recorded in the net assets section or liabilities section of the consolidated balance sheet of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company of such subsidiary as share subscription rights, share options, non-controlling interests, or liabilities; where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero). (a) The amount equivalent to the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 of such consolidated subsidiary multiplied by 8.5%. (b) The amount of the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 related to such consolidated subsidiary multiplied by 8.5%.

(iii) The amount of adjusted minority interests, etc. relating to Tier 2 Capital set forth in Article 7, paragraph (1), item (v) shall be the amount obtained by deducting the sum of the amounts set forth in Article 5, paragraph (1), item (iv) and Article 6, paragraph (1), item (v) from an amount not exceeding the amount obtained by multiplying the lesser of the following amounts by the third-party interest ratio relating to total capital (meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the amount of basic items relating to total capital equivalent to non-controlling interests, etc. of a consolidated subsidiary by the amount of standalone total capital basic items), using as the base the amount of basic items relating to total capital equivalent to non-controlling interests, etc. of consolidated subsidiaries (meaning the portion of standalone total capital basic items recorded in the net assets section or liabilities section of the consolidated balance sheet of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company of such subsidiary as share subscription rights, share options, non-controlling interests, or liabilities; where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero). (a) The amount equivalent to the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 of such consolidated subsidiary multiplied by 10.5%. (b) The amount of the denominator of the formula of each item of Article 2 related to such consolidated subsidiary multiplied by 10.5%.

children.text_en: In calculating the amount provided in item (ii) of the preceding paragraph, where a consolidated subsidiary has a special purpose company, etc. that is a subsidiary of such consolidated subsidiary, the amount of capital instruments issued by such special purpose company, etc. may be included in the amount of basic items relating to Additional Tier 1 Capital under such item only if all of the following requirements are satisfied. (i) The amount of self-held common shares set forth in Article 5, paragraph (2), item (ii) shall be the amount of the capital instruments (hereinafter referred to as "self-held capital instruments" in items (ii) and (iii), the following paragraph, and Article 10, paragraph (2), item (vi)) of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. (excluding those that are treasury shares (meaning treasury shares as provided in Article 2, item (xix) of the Consolidated Financial Statements Regulation)) that qualify as common shares, where the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. holds its own capital instruments (including cases that are deemed equivalent to constructively holding such instruments through investments or similar acts in juridical persons, etc. (meaning companies, partnerships, and other entities similar thereto; the same applies hereinafter) that are not included in the scope of consolidation for purposes of calculating the consolidated capital adequacy ratio (hereinafter referred to as "non-consolidated juridical persons, etc." in this Article) and similar cases).

(ii) The amount of self-held Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments set forth in Article 6, paragraph (2), item (i) shall be the amount of self-held capital instruments that qualify as Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments.

(iii) The amount of self-held Tier 2 Capital instruments set forth in Article 7, paragraph (2), item (i) shall be the amount of self-held capital instruments that qualify as Tier 2 Capital instruments.

children.text_ja: 第五条第二項第三号、第六条第二項第二号並びに第七条第二項第二号及び第三項第一号に掲げる額は、次に定めるところにより算出した額とする。一第五条第二項第三号に掲げる意図的に保有している他の金融機関等の普通株式の額は、最終指定親会社等が金融機関若しくはこれに準ずる外国の者又は金融業、保険業その他の業種に属する事業を主たる事業として営む者(これに準ずる外国の者を含み、金融システムに影響を及ぼすおそれがないと認められる者その他の者を除く。)であって、連結自己資本規制比率の算出に当たり連結の範囲に含まれないもの(以下この章において「他の金融機関等」という。)との間で相互に自己資本規制比率(法第四十六条の六に規定する自己資本規制比率をいう。以下この号において同じ。)(TLAC規制対象会社又はその連結子法人等にあっては、自己資本規制比率又は外部TLAC比率(最終指定親会社TLAC告示第二条第一項に規定する外部TLAC比率をいう。))若しくはこれと類似の比率を向上させるため、意図的に当該他の金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段(対象資本調達手段(資本調達手段のうち、普通株式に相当するもの(みなし普通株式(普通株式、その他Tier1資本調達手段又はTier2資本調達手段のいずれにも相当しない資本調達手段をいう。)を含む。以下この条において同じ。)、その他Tier1資本調達手段に相当するもの又はTier2資本調達手段に相当するもの(規制金融機関の資本調達手段にあっては、当該規制金融機関に適用される経営の健全性を判断するための基準又はこれと類似の基準において連結自己資本規制比率の算式の分子の額を構成するものに相当するものに限る。)をいう。)又はその他外部TLAC関連調達手段をいう。以下この条及び第十条第二項第六号において同じ。)を保有していると認められ、かつ、当該他の金融機関等が意図的に当該最終指定親会社等の普通株式、その他Tier1資本調達手段、Tier2資本調達手段又はその他外部TLAC関連調達手段を保有していると認められる場合(最終指定親会社等又は他の金融機関等が連結範囲外の法人等に対する投資その他これに類する行為を通じて実質的に保有している場合に相当すると認められる場合その他これに準ずる場合を含む。)における当該他の金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段(以下この項において「意図的に保有している他の金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段」という。)のうち普通株式に相当するものの額とする。二第六条第二項第二号に掲げる意図的に保有している他の金融機関等のその他Tier1資本調達手段の額は、意図的に保有している他の金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段のうちその他Tier1資本調達手段に相当するものの額とする。三第七条第二項第二号に掲げる意図的に保有している他の金融機関等のTier2資本調達手段の額は、意図的に保有している他の金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段のうちTier2資本調達手段に相当するものの額とする。四第七条第三項第一号に掲げる意図的に保有している他の金融機関等のその他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額は、意図的に保有している他の金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段のうちその他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額とする。
children.text_en: The amounts set forth in Article 5, paragraph (2), item (iii), Article 6, paragraph (2), item (ii), and Article 7, paragraph (2), item (ii) and paragraph (3), item (i) shall be calculated as follows. (i) The amount of common shares of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally set forth in Article 5, paragraph (2), item (iii) shall be the amount equivalent to common shares of the target capital, etc. instruments (hereinafter referred to as "target capital, etc. instruments of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally" in this paragraph) of other financial institutions, etc. (meaning financial institutions or their foreign equivalents, or persons whose principal business is in the financial, insurance, or other sectors (including their foreign equivalents, but excluding those deemed to have no risk of affecting the financial system and others); the same applies hereinafter in this Chapter) that are not included in the scope of consolidation for purposes of calculating the consolidated capital adequacy ratio, in cases where the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. is deemed to intentionally hold the target capital, etc. instruments (meaning target capital instruments (meaning capital instruments equivalent to common shares (including deemed common shares (meaning capital instruments equivalent to none of common shares, Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments, or Tier 2 Capital instruments)), instruments equivalent to Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments, or instruments equivalent to Tier 2 Capital instruments (in the case of capital instruments of regulated financial institutions, limited to those equivalent to instruments constituting the numerator of the consolidated capital adequacy ratio formula under the standards applicable to such regulated financial institutions or similar standards)) or other external TLAC-related instruments; the same applies hereinafter in this Article and Article 10, paragraph (2), item (vi)) of such other financial institutions, etc. in order to mutually improve the capital adequacy ratio (meaning the capital adequacy ratio as provided in Article 46-6 of the Act; the same applies hereinafter in this item) (in the case of TLAC-regulated companies or their consolidated subsidiaries, the capital adequacy ratio or the external TLAC ratio (meaning the external TLAC ratio as provided in Article 2, paragraph (1) of the TLAC Public Notice for Ultimate Designated Parent Companies)) or similar ratios with such other financial institutions, etc., and where such other financial institutions, etc. are deemed to intentionally hold common shares, Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments, Tier 2 Capital instruments, or other external TLAC-related instruments of such Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. (including cases deemed equivalent to constructive holding through investments or similar acts in non-consolidated juridical persons, etc. by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. or other financial institutions, etc., and similar cases). (ii) The amount of Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally set forth in Article 6, paragraph (2), item (ii) shall be the amount of target capital, etc. instruments of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally that are equivalent to Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments. (iii) The amount of Tier 2 Capital instruments of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally set forth in Article 7, paragraph (2), item (ii) shall be the amount of target capital, etc. instruments of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally that are equivalent to Tier 2 Capital instruments. (iv) The amount of other external TLAC-related instruments of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally set forth in Article 7, paragraph (3), item (i) shall be the amount of other external TLAC-related instruments among the target capital, etc. instruments of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally.

clauses_ja.text: 第五条第二項第三号、第六条第二項第二号並びに第七条第二項第二号及び第三項第一号に掲げる額は、次に定めるところにより算出した額とする。
一第五条第二項第三号に掲げる意図的に保有している他の金融機関等の普通株式の額は、最終指定親会社等が金融機関若しくはこれに準ずる外国の者又は金融業、保険業その他の業種に属する事業を主たる事業として営む者
(これに準ずる外国の者を含み、金融システムに影響を及ぼすおそれがないと認められる者その他の者を除く。)
であって、連結自己資本規制比率の算出に当たり連結の範囲に含まれないもの
(以下この章において「他の金融機関等」という。)
との間で相互に自己資本規制比率
(法第四十六条の六に規定する自己資本規制比率をいう。以下この号において同じ。)
(TLAC規制対象会社又はその連結子法人等にあっては、自己資本規制比率又は外部TLAC比率(最終指定親会社TLAC告示第二条第一項に規定する外部TLAC比率をいう。))
若しくはこれと類似の比率を向上させるため、意図的に当該他の金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段

(対象資本調達手段(資本調達手段のうち、普通株式に相当するもの(みなし普通株式(普通株式、その他Tier1資本調達手段又はTier2資本調達手段のいずれにも相当しない資本調達手段をいう。)を含む。以下この条において同じ。)、その他Tier1資本調達手段に相当するもの又はTier2資本調達手段に相当するもの(規制金融機関の資本調達手段にあっては、当該規制金融機関に適用される経営の健全性を判断するための基準又はこれと類似の基準において連結自己資本規制比率の算式の分子の額を構成するものに相当するものに限る。)をいう。)又はその他外部TLAC関連調達手段をいう。以下この条及び第十条第二項第六号において同じ。)
を保有していると認められ、かつ、当該他の金融機関等が意図的に当該最終指定親会社等の普通株式、その他Tier1資本調達手段、Tier2資本調達手段又はその他外部TLAC関連調達手段を保有していると認められる場合
(最終指定親会社等又は他の金融機関等が連結範囲外の法人等に対する投資その他これに類する行為を通じて実質的に保有している場合に相当すると認められる場合その他これに準ずる場合を含む。)
における当該他の金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段
(以下この項において「意図的に保有している他の金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段」という。)
のうち普通株式に相当するものの額とする。
二第六条第二項第二号に掲げる意図的に保有している他の金融機関等のその他Tier1資本調達手段の額は、意図的に保有している他の金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段のうちその他Tier1資本調達手段に相当するものの額とする。
三第七条第二項第二号に掲げる意図的に保有している他の金融機関等のTier2資本調達手段の額は、意図的に保有している他の金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段のうちTier2資本調達手段に相当するものの額とする。
四第七条第三項第一号に掲げる意図的に保有している他の金融機関等のその他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額は、意図的に保有している他の金融機関等の対象資本等調達手段のうちその他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額とする。

clauses_en.text: The amounts set forth in Article 5, paragraph (2), item (iii), Article 6, paragraph (2), item (ii), and Article 7, paragraph (2), item (ii) and paragraph (3), item (i) shall be calculated as follows.

(i) The amount of common shares of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally set forth in Article 5, paragraph (2), item (iii) shall be the amount equivalent to common shares among the target capital, etc. instruments (meaning target capital instruments (meaning capital instruments equivalent to common shares (including deemed common shares (meaning capital instruments equivalent to none of common shares, Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments, or Tier 2 Capital instruments)), instruments equivalent to Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments, or instruments equivalent to Tier 2 Capital instruments (in the case of capital instruments of regulated financial institutions, limited to those equivalent to instruments constituting the numerator amount of the consolidated capital adequacy ratio formula under the applicable standards or similar standards)) or other external TLAC-related instruments; the same applies hereinafter in this Article and Article 10, paragraph (2), item (vi)) of other financial institutions, etc. (meaning financial institutions or their foreign equivalents, or persons whose principal business is in the financial, insurance, or other sectors (including their foreign equivalents, but excluding those deemed to have no risk of affecting the financial system and others); the same applies hereinafter in this Chapter) not included in the scope of consolidation, in cases where the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. is deemed to intentionally hold such instruments to mutually improve capital adequacy ratios with such other financial institutions, etc., and where such other financial institutions, etc. are also deemed to intentionally hold common shares, Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments, Tier 2 Capital instruments, or other external TLAC-related instruments of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. (hereinafter referred to as "target capital, etc. instruments of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally" in this paragraph).

(ii) The amount of Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally set forth in Article 6, paragraph (2), item (ii) shall be the amount of target capital, etc. instruments of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally that are equivalent to Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments.

(iii) The amount of Tier 2 Capital instruments of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally set forth in Article 7, paragraph (2), item (ii) shall be the amount of target capital, etc. instruments of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally that are equivalent to Tier 2 Capital instruments.

(iv) The amount of other external TLAC-related instruments of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally set forth in Article 7, paragraph (3), item (i) shall be the amount of other external TLAC-related instruments among the target capital, etc. instruments of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally.
